title: Empowering Our Partners to Win in the Agentic AI Era
summary: Cisco is empowering our partners to win in the agentic AI era.
body_markdown:
The agentic AI era is here, and it is reshaping the demands on enterprise infrastructure at an unprecedented pace. AI workloads and agentic workflows have become mission-critical, and the network has become both the vital foundation and the primary risk vector.


At Cisco Partner Summit 2026, we are putting tools, incentives, and insights directly into the hands of our partners to ensure you can lead this next major wave of innovation.


## Building an agile partner ecosystem


True ecosystem agility requires a program that evolves as quickly as the market moves. With the Cisco 360 Partner Program nearing its first full year of deployment, we’re[furthering our investments](https://blogs.cisco.com/partner/you-asked-for-more-money-and-more-time-heres-both) in rewarding every type of partner for the unique value they bring to our shared customers. Whether you’re an advisor shaping strategy, a developer building solutions, or a distributor enabling transactions, we’ve designed new ways to recognize the importance of your contributions:


- **Ecosystem Deal Registration** the influence that shapes a deal.
- New dedicated paths for **Advisors and Developers** provide a new way of recognizing and giving credit to these partners for their pre-sale role.


These updates provide a unified value chain that benefits all of our partners at every step of the customer lifecycle.

## Unified, resilient, secure, and AI-ready infrastructure


As AI agents scale, so does the risk of performance bottlenecks and identity-based threats. To stay competitive, partners need to deliver infrastructure that is as intelligent as the applications running on top of it. Today, Cisco is making this possible through[several critical innovations](https://blogs.cisco.com/news/powering-partner-potential-in-a-world-of-agentic-ai) :


- **[Cloud Control & Model Foundry](https://blogs.cisco.com/ai/cisco-model-foundry-partner-summit)** : Cisco Cloud Control is a shared platform that gives teams and AI agents a unified environment to manage infrastructure and resolve issues. We’re expanding Cloud Control with Model Foundry, a new service that makes it easy to discover, evaluate, fine-tune, and run Cisco’s purpose-built AI models on your own data, all in one place. Model Foundry also provides exclusive early access to Cisco’s latest model versions and weights ahead of broader release.
- **ThousandEyes intelligence** : We are embedding always-on ThousandEyes intelligence natively into Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 access points, enabling automated background testing, strengthening customer trust in agentic actions.
- **Agentic integration** : We’re introducing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for our network platforms that can act as a standardized bridge between AI tools and live network data, eliminating the need for partners to build and maintain complex custom connections.
- **Quantum readiness** : We are unveiling the industry’s first Wi-Fi 7 access point with quantum-resilient capabilities, helping to future-proof our customers’ infrastructure.
- [Privileged Infrastructure Access](https://blogs.cisco.com/security/cisco-rethinks-privileged-infrastructure-access) : Through our partnership with Teleport, we are bringing just-in-time, just-enough access to Cisco routers and switches, so network teams keep critical work moving and privilege expires when the work is done.
- ****Reducing exposure on more devices:**** Live Protect vulnerability shields reduce the exposure on Cisco devices between disclosure and the permanent software fix. We are extending this capability to include Cisco routers, campus gateway, and firewall products.


## The agentic shift is underway


The shift we’re experiencing towards agentic infrastructure is likely to be the greatest opportunity for our partner community in decades. By combining the innovations announced today with the strength of the Cisco 360 Partner Program, we are empowering you to turn the complexity of the agentic AI era into a competitive advantage for you and for your customers.


I encourage you to[explore these new offerings](https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2026/m10/cisco-expands-partner-opportunity-with-new-cisco-360-program-updates-high-yield-customer-experience-offerings-and-ai-ready-innovations.html) at Partner Summit and connect with your Cisco teams to see how we can accelerate your growth together.
